tween the reactants and the product is established over Fe-based catalysts in the reactor.

and rate-limiting step in the biosynthesis of the neurotransmitter dopamine. In this first step, L-DOPA is

and ferrous ions. In a subsequent step, another enzyme transforms L-DOPA into dopamine.
